changes.comment: `RepoStateCache` now compares the content of the Git configuration and attributes files, not their timestamps, so a file that Git rewrites with the same content, for example the repository's configuration when `git branch -D` deletes a branch, no longer makes the next calls copy the Git index and hash files again. A missing file counts as an empty one. The cache still copies the index again after a call during which one of these files may have been written.
